policy: Engineering evidence from agents sharing one operator or device may improve software confidence, but it never becomes organizational, custody, validator, or governance independence.

TWO_RUNNER_TESTNET.purpose: Run the same pinned source through two distinct AI runtimes before any mainnet action.

DORMANT_MAINNET.purpose: Optionally timestamp source and policy provenance without deploying an economic system.

MATURE_MAINNET.purpose: Deploy the immutable token and economic kernels only after independent evidence exists.

nonEquivalence: Two AI products on one computer are two engineering runtimes, not two independent operators.
Two wallets controlled by one person are not independent custody domains.
A dormant provenance anchor is not an APOOL token deployment and cannot later activate one.
Mature economics require a new deployment that passes every mainnet gate.
